coastal.title: Businesses relieved by reopening of Highway 1 through B.C.'s Fraser Canyon
coastal.description: Part of the Trans-Canada Highway was shut down on July 7 as the Brunswick wildfire complex raged near Boston Bar. The fires are still burning, but, on Wednesday, the province  deemed it safe enough  for a partial reopening.

kamloops.title: Summerland wildfire that forced thousands out of homes now being held
kamloops.description: The B.C. Wildfire Service says the blaze is expected to remain within its current perimeter of about 252 square kilometres west of Summerland.

kamloops.title: B.C. Conservative MLA makes move to repeal DRIPA
kamloops.description: A B.C. Conservative MLA is trying to repeal the province's Declaration on the Rights of Indigenous Peoples Act (DRIPA).

kamloops.title: Tree-mapping tool piloted in Kelowna is expanding across B.C. to cool down cities
kamloops.description: A  University of British Columbia-led pilot project in Kelowna is expanding to Vancouver. It looks to change how local governments approach urban shade and planting trees.

southeast.title: A painful homecoming: Faulder residents return to see what the Bald range fire left behind
southeast.description: Residents of Faulder were finally allowed to return to their properties, getting their first chance to walk through the areas hit by the Bald Range wildfire

all.title: The where, when and how of fuel treatment decisions
all.description: With a big landscape, a limited budget and a diverse set of community objectives, how do we decide where, when and how fuel treatments are best undertaken to reduce wildfire risks? all.title: Wildland firefighters warned not to take supplements for smoke or PFAS exposure
all.description: A drug marketed to wildland firefighters exposed to smoke or PFAS shows no evidence of being effective, leading the International Association of Firefighters and the Food and Drug Administration to warn against its use. The drug, called glutathione, is marketed to fire fighters to remove toxins, but the IAFF says there are no scientific studies […]

all.title: Studying combined fuel treatments gives us a better picture of effectiveness
all.description: While many studies have established that fuel treatments are an effective wildfire mitigation tool, the gap in our understanding has been how a range of different treatments work together over many years across large areas to produce a desired outcome. Research led by Boise State University PhD student Kendra Fallon, now a National Fire Ecologist […]

all.title: Another MLA leaves BC Conservative Party as Bruce Banman announces exit
all.description: 'The goal in politics is to make the tent bigger. To listen to the majority. It’s not about left or right. It’s about doing what’s right,' Bruce Banman said in a statement.

all.title: B.C. to pilot forestry model to assist industry, improve wildfire mitigation
all.description: A proposed new provincial forest model aims to assist B.C.’s struggling forestry industry and aid in wildfire mitigation, but environmentalists worry it may lead to conservation problems.

all.title: B.C. ends wildfire-related state of emergency, offroad vehicle ban to be lifted
all.description: B.C.'s forests minister says a province-wide state of emergency has ended, but wildfire risk remains.
